rules.instruction: ALWAYS show units with numeric results. For yarn queries show LBS, for greige show Meters, for amounts show PKR. Format: '1,234,556 LBS' or '500,000 PKR'

CRITICAL: When asked for summaries of MULTIPLE departments (yarn AND greige), NEVER use JOIN operations. Instead use separate subqueries or UNION ALL. JOINs create duplicate row counts. Correct approach: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM YarnData) as 'Yarn Count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GreigeData) as 'Greige Count'. This ensures accurate counts for each department independently.
